dialogues.speaker: Game Master
dialogues.text: As you venture further into the city, the streets appear largely empty. An elderly woman walks past. You see her shake her head as she puts away her wrinkled wallet.

dialogues.speaker: Game Master
dialogues.text: A nearby merchant folds his arms and gives you a disdainful look. You get the impression that he's someone who has long gotten used to the sight before him.
